claims.statement:
For the fixed nonidentity P in BLS12-381 G1 supplied by the challenge and uniform z in the order-r subgroup of GT (identity included), the disclosed classical algorithm returns Q in G2 with the pinned reduced pairing e(P,Q)=z with success 0.3965 (the birthday row; CP-95 lower 0.3965, above the 0.39 floor), and its complete classical work is at most 2^125.7692 dense-Fp12-multiplication equivalents at the protected C=20000, summed over all processors with no amortisation. THE CLAIM IS NOW TAKEN FROM ONE SUM, NOT FROM W_stress: ledger.total_all() adds S*c_stress (2^125.768378) + the cap/trap charge (rate*cap*price) + every row of ledger.aux() (2^56.510, enumerated) + an aux reserve (2^114.812) that keeps the claim above the previously DISCLOSED aux reading, and claim_from_total() returns the least 4-decimal log2 value above log2 of that sum plus 2e-5 bits. audit_v24.py asserts claim >= log2(total) both as a Fraction comparison and in the log domain. v23 took the claim from log2(W_stress) alone and printed aux beside it; the reviewer added the parts by hand and the claim came out below its own components. The honest sum lands at 2^125.769104 and the claim is 125.7692, which still clears the live board minimum 125.82 by 0.0508 bits and sits below the 125.8345 legality line.

DEFECT 2, THE CYCLE FAMILY, KILLED STRUCTURALLY NOT DEBITED. The family the reviewer quoted from classkey.py: two consecutive multiply steps on the SAME row t with kappa(y')=kappa(y)+6 use columns k and k+6, and TBL[t][k+6] IS the inverse of TBL[t][k] (toy_census counts 6R such pairs), so y returns EXACTLY and the trail is absorbing. v24 forbids the PRECONDITION: classkey.step_v24 redraws the row when it repeats the previous multiply row, t' = t XOR (1 + h mod (R-1)), a bijection of the other R-1 rows, so two consecutive multiply steps NEVER share a row. The row marginal stays exactly uniform and the pair law is uniform on ordered pairs of distinct rows (statistical distance from iid uniform <= 1/R per step). The exact return now needs w_t(L)=0 for two DIFFERENT rows, a different and non-absorbing equation. Cost: constants.ROWDIFF = 16 instructions on the multiply channel, charged on every multiply step: fold_mul 1873 -> 1889, mul_step 21889, W_stress 2^125.768378, +0.00097 bits disclosed, not hidden. The v13 step is kept as the control that carries the family.

DEFECT 3, STATISTICS, REBUILT AND HONESTLY SPLIT. v24_measure.recovery_census is a SINGLE product from the SAME paired runs: for each trial one planted secret x0 and one z=g^x0, two trails with INDEPENDENT label pairs (y_i=g^a_i z^b_i), each run to its FIRST distinguished point or to the 128*theta cap, and the trial counts as a recovery only if BOTH reach a DP, the two DP CLASS KEYS are equal, and the twelve-shift solve returns exactly the planted x0. 12006 trials: both reach a DP 0.5456, same DP class given both 0.1701, solve verifies given the same class 0.9991, UNCONDITIONAL 0.0927 (CP-95 lower 0.0884, bootstrap 400x). This is the fixture-scale rate at N=785, where theta=32 sits ON the cycle length sqrt(N)=28, so the fixture is cycle-dominated and CANNOT measure the production rate; it is shipped labelled as mechanism, and the production row is the model plus a theorem, not an extrapolation of this mean. The theorem is the union bound P(a class repeat within t steps) <= t(t-1)/2N, with NO fixture input: t=cap=128*2^80 and N=2^371 give <= 2^-198, and over one report interval theta^2/2N = 2^-92.3, which is the row charged in ledger.trap_charge. The birthday row is not taken at a mean tau: E[1-exp(-tau^2/2N)] is bounded below in the tau>=1 (smallest) direction and the count uses S^2(1-f^2) directly. mu=11/10 is kept only as the disclosed walk-quality allowance it has been since v18; it is not re-derived here.

DEFECT 4, CENSUS INTEGRITY. v23 built TC.Toy(seed=20261024) in EVERY worker and drew start points from toy.rand_gt(), which advances toy.rng: worker i's j-th start WAS worker 0's j-th start, so 264 scheduled walks carried ~33 distinct trajectories. v24 draws every start from random.Random(BASE_SEED + 1000*worker) (toy.rand_gt(rng)), and recovery_census returns worker_first_starts plus the assert that they are pairwise DISTINCT (measured: True, 6 workers). The 256-vs-264 discrepancy is not patched by relabelling: v24 reports the ACTUAL trial count of every census (12006 trials, 44 family walks, 24012 trails) and never a header.

WORK AND ARITHMETIC. fold_mul 1889 = 32+8+32+32+72+28+1613+16+16 (integer resum asserted), mul_step 21889, c_stress 0.9640325, S = 75155834044258079300444605238535429486, W_stress 2^125.768378. Trap charge = rate*cap*price with rate = 2^-92.3, cap = 128*2^80, price = c_mul_stress: 0.0526 reference units. Aux rows enumerated (table_build, gt_exp_starts, restart_bookkeeping, report_writes, store_lookup, report_cap_drain, solve, verify) and summed by Fraction to 2^56.510. Total 2^125.769104, claim 125.7692, claim - total = 0.000096 bits. No guard ring is charged (no ring exists): GUARD row 0, ROWDIFF 16.

GATES. No production-size run; the fixture cannot measure the production rate and is labelled mechanism. Success is conditional on the disclosed mu=11/10 allowance, pseudorandom routing fields and ideal coins; no novelty claim. Unchanged from v23: no inversion-free sigma-stable column table (UNMET), class-marginal uniformity refuted at fixture scale (REFUTED, credit not taken), class-stream census stops at R=1024 (UNMET). The v23 verdict's own numbers (7503/7503 DP-gated, 56/56 cap control, 230.75 reports/walk) are superseded by this census and are not restated as the claim.

title: Same-row inverse-pair family KILLED in the step (rows must differ), per-worker seeds, one-sum claim 125.7692 (W_stress 2^125.768378 + aux + trap, integer-summed), unconditional fixture census 0.0927 labelled mechanism
